name: olachillbus
description: Coaches, minibuses and vans with driver for groups in the Schengen area of Europe: countries served, which vehicle fits, how to request a quote.

interface.shortDescription: Group coaches with driver in the Schengen area of Europe
interface.longDescription: Connects to the public, read-only OlaChill Bus MCP server (https://olachillbus.com/mcp). Lists the countries served, the vehicle classes that fit a group and its large suitcases, and where to request a quote on olachillbus.com. It never books, takes payment or confirms availability.
